_what: PRE-REGISTRATION for the ego_progress UNDER-SIDE audit (never tested by any injection suite in this programme) and for the over-side zero-mean repair. Written and staged BEFORE any under-side number was computed.
_author_note: ⛔ Everything below is committed in advance, in BOTH directions. Where I state an expectation I also state what I will write if it does NOT fire. A prediction that can only confirm is not a prediction — the sibling stream's own C47 prediction FAILED and that failure was its most useful result.

U_SUBSTRATES.decisive: v4_blind — 31.78 % of its DEFINED rows sit at ego_progress = 0 with r <= 0 (INHERITED from …/2026-07-28-bounded-terms-complete/raw/density.json). It is the only non-degenerate arm on the panel with real under-floor mass; every other scorable arm is <= 0.60 %.
U_SUBSTRATES.stress_synthetic: reverse_half = lon_scale(-0.5) applied to v1_tactical_follow — a plan that travels BACKWARDS at half the human's speed, so ~100 % of its rows are at r <= 0. ⛔ It is a METRIC-TEST SUBSTRATE, is never inserted into `arms`, and NEVER votes on any gate or ranking. Same role v1_ego_double played for the over side.
U_SUBSTRATES.degenerate_reference: stand_still — r = 0 on every row by construction; used ONLY to price the under-side range budget (U-6).

U_CONTROLS_AND_THE_DIRECTION_RULE.⭐ RULE U-0 (the brief's explicit demand:: A control is admissible as an UNDER-TRAVEL DEGRADATION on a given arm only if it INCREASES a METRIC-INDEPENDENT ground truth on that arm: the absolute along-track endpoint error |s_plan - s_human| (mean AND median), measured with a paired episode-cluster bootstrap and SEPARATED. A cell whose control fails this check is reported as REFUSED_CONTROL and is NOT counted as a metric failure. ⛔ This exists because lon_shift and lon_scale have a CONSTANT SIGN and can RE-CENTRE an arm that is biased the other way — control._ctl_lat_shift's own docstring warns of exactly this, and an under-travel injection is the shape that has fooled this programme before.

controls.name: lon_retime
controls.why: PATH-PRESERVING slowdown — re-samples the plan along its OWN polyline. The axis-pure under-travel control.

controls.name: lon_scale
controls.why: the panel's own v1_ego_half construction; kept for comparability, NOT axis-pure (it rotates every segment).

controls.name: lon_shift
controls.why: ⭐ NEW CONTROL. Constant along-track back-shift of every plan point — the exact along-track analogue of lat_shift, and the only control that pushes rows ALREADY at r <= 0 FURTHER backwards. Without it the under floor cannot be probed at all.

controls.name: lon_jitter
controls.why: ⭐⭐ THE LOAD-BEARING CELL. ZERO-MEAN along-track noise, one draw per row. Its expectation is 0 by construction, so it CANNOT re-centre a bias and its direction is unambiguous: it strictly adds error and must therefore LOWER any sound progress score.

U-1 the direction check nobody has ever.claim: On cv_holdv0 and v1_tactical_follow a CONSTANT SLOWDOWN (lon_retime 0.7 and 0.5) LOWERS ego_progress, SEPARATED, under BOTH clamp_v1 and twosided_v2.
U-1 the direction check nobody has ever.expect: PASS on both terms. The published docstring asserts clamp_v1 'punishes going too slow' — that has never been measured by injection and is being measured here for the first time.
U-1 the direction check nobody has ever.if_it_fails: the under half of a weight-5.0 term is broken in the plainest possible way and every downstream result in this report is void; I will lead with that and stop.

U-2 the reversal floor.claim: On the reversing substrate (~100 % of rows at r <= 0) a FURTHER reversal (a deeper lon_shift, or lon_scale -0.5 -> -1.0) is charged NOTHING.
U-2 the reversal floor.expect: FAIL — delta ~ 0.0000, degenerate, IDENTICALLY under clamp_v1 and twosided_v2, because the two terms are bit-identical for r <= 1 and both floor at r <= 0. A plan reversing 1 m and a plan reversing 10 m score the same 0.0000.
U-2 the reversal floor.if_it_does_not_fire: the under floor is not reachable by any realisable degradation and E-3 can be closed as MEASURED-BENIGN; I will say so and drop the fix.

U-3 ⭐⭐ THE LOAD-BEARING ZERO-MEAN CELL.claim: On v4_blind (31.78 % under-floor) a ZERO-MEAN lon_jitter(sigma = 2 m) RAISES ego_progress — the C45 mechanism, on the side nobody has audited.
U-3 ⭐⭐ THE LOAD-BEARING ZERO-MEAN CELL.expect: delta > 0 and SEPARATED under clamp_v1. Under twosided_v2 I expect the SAME SIGN but a SMALLER magnitude, because twosided_v2 charges the positive draws that clamp_v1 ceilings away. ⇒ a DISCRIMINATING prediction: clamp_v1's leak must exceed twosided_v2's on this arm.
U-3 ⭐⭐ THE LOAD-BEARING ZERO-MEAN CELL.if_it_does_not_fire: the under floor is measurably benign at the panel's own density and I will write that the under side is SOUND at 31.78 % floor — which would be a genuine surprise given the over side leaked at 23.42 %.

U-4 the NaN hazard, asserted rather than.claim: ego_progress is NaN iff the HUMAN's 2 s chord <= 0.5 m — a property of the LOGGED path, not of the plan. Its defined_frac must therefore be EXACTLY invariant under every plan-space injection.
U-4 the NaN hazard, asserted rather than.test: ASSERTED bit-exactly on every cell. ⚠️ The COMPOSITE's definedness is NOT invariant (recovery's mask xt_hold > 0.10 m is plan-dependent and a barely-moving plan yields recovery = NaN BY CONSTRUCTION — a slowdown once raised the composite +0.1698 this way). defined_frac is published for every composite cell and any cell moving it by more than 0.5 pp is read as CONFOUNDED, not as a metric verdict.

U-5 the negative control.claim: On cv_holdv0 (under-floor 0.50 %) the same zero-mean lon_jitter must NOT be rewarded.
U-5 the negative control.expect: delta <= 0 under twosided_v2. Under clamp_v1 I expect delta < 0 as well — not because clamp_v1 is sound but because its CEILING at r >= 1 clips 26 % of that arm's rows, and a clipped ceiling is CONCAVE, which charges zero-mean noise. ⇒ the two ends of the same clamp bias in OPPOSITE directions, and which one wins is a fact about the arm's density, not about the term.

U-6 the under-side fix, and the reason I.arithmetic: Any bounded g: R -> [0,1] that agrees with clamp_v1 on [0,1] has g(0) = 0, and g >= 0 forces g == 0 on (-inf, 0]. ⇒ A STRICT REFINEMENT OF THE UNDER SIDE IS PROVABLY IMPOSSIBLE — identical in structure to C47's impossibility proof for recovery. Charging reversal requires g(0) = p > 0, i.e. a RANGE BUDGET with a free parameter, exactly recovery's q.
U-6 the under-side fix, and the reason I.expect: REFUSE the budget on a MEASURED semantic ground: p > 0 pays a plan that does not move. stand_still is at r = 0 on 100 % of rows and would rise 0.0000 -> p. This programme has already been burned by exactly that (the v0-based recovery denominator put the BLIND arm +0.597 above the sighted one; 'standing still is not recovery'). I commit in advance to publishing p's price on stand_still and on v4_blind and letting the number decide, not the argument.
U-6 the under-side fix, and the reason I.if_the_price_is_low: I will ship the budget as a versioned non-default term with the full ranking impact published.

U-7 the resolution lever, checked before.claim: The brief's ⭐ lever: lat_heading was one value per row BY IMPLEMENTATION CHOICE and a 20-step mean cut its worst floor 32.4x with no free parameter. ego_progress has the SAME structure — score_windows uses ONLY the terminal along-track distance (x[:, -1] over the human's 2 s chord) although the plan has 20 steps and the reference has 20 matching poses.
U-7 the resolution lever, checked before.expect: a per-step resolution (mean over the k with human_k > 0.5 m — the PUBLISHED constant, reused verbatim, so no new parameter) lowers the floor fraction on both ends. ⚠️ AND I EXPECT A NEW PATHOLOGY: r_k = x_k / human_k has a SMALL DENOMINATOR at early k, so a constant along-track offset e produces e/human_k which EXPLODES at k = 1 — the exact structural twin of the step-0 tangent that destroyed the `mean` resolution for lat_heading. If that fires, the resolution lever does NOT transfer and I will say so rather than shipping it.

O_PREDICTIONS_over_side.O-0 reproduction of the inherited failin: My twosided_v2 numbers on the 12 published over-side cells must reproduce …/2026-07-28-bounded-terms-complete/raw/injections_ego_progress.json EXACTLY (same controls, same arms, same B = 2000, same seed). ASSERTED before any new shape is scored.
O_PREDICTIONS_over_side.O-1 the acceptance rule: A term PASSES only if every VERIFIED-DIRECTION cell moves NEGATIVE and SEPARATED — over side (4 injections x 3 arms) AND under side. The zero-mean cells are load-bearing on both sides.
O_PREDICTIONS_over_side.O-2 ⛔ THE PREDICTION I EXPECT TO CONSTRA: A term LINEAR on its live range has E[g(r + delta)] = g(r) exactly for zero-mean delta, so it can never SEPARATE on a zero-mean cell — it can only be n.s. Charging zero-mean noise requires CONCAVITY where the data lives. But a bounded, decreasing, CONCAVE function must reach 0 at finite r and stay there, and that floor is a CONVEX kink which REWARDS the same noise. ⇒ I predict the grid is a TRADE, not a search, and that the winner is whichever shape puts its concave region on the density and its convex kink beyond it. ⛔ BOTH OUTCOMES COMMITTED: if some term scores a clean sweep I will ship it and this prediction is refuted; if none does, the correct deliverable is the PROOF of the trade plus the measured frontier, and 'the composite is sound end to end' still may not be written.
O_PREDICTIONS_over_side.O-3 the shapes swept: clamp_v1 (published); lin/twosided w in {1/3, 0.5, 1, 2} (floor at r = 1 + 1/w); hyp_w = 1/(1 + w(r-1)) — NEVER floors and has the SAME charge rate w at r = 1 as lin_w, so it is the shape that answers 'move the floor without halving the rate'; exp_w = exp(-w(r-1)) — never floors, same rate at r = 1; sqrtlin_w = sqrt(max(1 - w(r-1), 0)) — the only CONCAVE member, floors at the same r = 1 + 1/w as lin_w. Every one of them is a STRICT REFINEMENT: bit-identical to clamp_v1 for r <= 1.
O_PREDICTIONS_over_side.O-4 C47, re-derived here and NOT inherit: C47 was AMENDED today to BOUNDED: the same share form scored 0/8 on recovery and 10/10 on lat_heading, and q = 0.5 lost on one and won on the other. The reward-bias proxy only predicts the outcome when the median row sits ABOVE the anchor. ⇒ I re-measure the charge rate at THIS term's own density, per substrate arm, and inherit no verdict. Note the substrates differ sharply: cv_holdv0 median r = 0.983 (BELOW the anchor r = 1) and v1_ego_double median r = 1.956 (ABOVE it), so C47's own boundary condition is straddled INSIDE this one experiment.

CONTAMINATION_PANEL.rule: ⚠️ A term can pass its injections and still be wrong — the plain-mean lat_heading candidate scored 10/10 and was killed by contamination. ego_progress's defining claim is that it measures ALONG-TRACK travel. ⇒ purely LATERAL degradations (lat_shift +-2 m, lat_jitter 1 m, yaw_bias 5 deg) must move it LEAST: max|delta| over the lateral controls must be < min|delta| over the verified longitudinal injections, on both real arms.
CONTAMINATION_PANEL.note: yaw_bias is included although it is not a pure translation: rotating a plan DOES shorten its along-track projection, so it is expected to move ego_progress a little. It is reported, and only lat_shift/lat_jitter carry the purity rule.
